endpoints.name: cog-manifold-ltx
gpuTypeIds: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition

notes: LTX-2.3 uncensored v1.4 fp8mixed adult lane (H3-compatible request contract). Weights live on network volume manifold-models (65aknc5k8g, 150 GB, EU-NL-1) under /runpod-volume/ltx-models and are fetched from the R2 manifest only if missing. The volume pins the endpoint to EU-NL-1, where RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell (same ~28 s clip as H100, about half the price) is first choice and H100 80GB HBM3 the fallback; the 5090 is not offered in that datacenter. H3 steps 8..30 remap to LTX base steps 6..10 (20 -> 8); last_frame, keyframes>2 and loop are routed to PinkCherry by the server. The app keeps workersMax at 0 between bursts (H3_LTX_RUNPOD_ENDPOINT, H3_LTX_RUNPOD_MAX_WORKERS). See results/ltx-vs-pinkcherry/README.md.
